Half of them start in the codebase."
Ingest any GitHub repo → 6 parallel engines → single scored, governance-enforced health report
→ SAST: SQL injection, eval(), pickle.loads(), MD5 hashing
→ Secrets: AWS keys, GitHub PATs, Stripe keys, DB URIs
→ Misconfigs: CORS *, debug mode, HTTP base URLs
Tools: AST metrics · File pattern analysis
→ Complexity: nesting depth, function size, file length
Tools: madge (circular deps) · Heuristic signal maps
→ Framework detection: Next.js, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Rails
→ God object detection | Coupling & layering violations
Tools: File pattern matching · YAML analysis
→ CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines
→ Dockerfile: multi-stage, non-root USER, pinned tags
→ Hygiene: LICENSE, SECURITY.md, Dependabot, lock files
→ CVE scanning against lock files (npm, Poetry, Maven)
→ Package staleness | transitive depth | supply chain
→ 1 committed secret = entire run flagged NON-COMPLIANT
WHY YOU CAN RELY ON IT
